description: Ingest a PDF, DOCX, CSV, HTML, JSON, or Markdown document into the workspace's grounded knowledge base and optionally distill atomic memories.

content.description: Plain text, Markdown, CSV, HTML, or JSON content

distill.description: Whether to distill atomic workspace memories from the document (default true)

fileBase64.description: Base64-encoded binary payload (for PDF or DOCX uploads)

filename.description: Original filename with extension (e.g. policy.pdf, handbook.docx)

name: ingest_document
